metadata.title: Double Exposure Portrait with Incised Serif Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A dual-profile portrait featuring a man in patterned sunglasses, rendered through a soft double exposure that creates a horizontal motion blur effect. The composition is bookended by textured, incised serif typography at the top and bottom margins.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the left and right profile orientations
Horizontal motion blur connecting the two facial figures
Contrast between the sharp sunglasses patterns and the soft skin tones
Typographic framing that anchors the ethereal central image
coreInvariants: Soft-focus or motion-blurred transition between subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large-scale profiles facing inward/outward, occupying the left and right thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast, patterned sunglasses on the right-side profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Horizontal flow from left to right, guided by the motion blur and the gaze of the profiles.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The central blurred area acts as a transitional negative space, softening the impact of the dual subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm skin tones and muted blues in the blurred background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep shadows in the hair and facial features.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red, white, and blue patterns on the sunglass frames.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value highlights on the nose and brow.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a film-stock grain and desaturation

letterConstructionRules: Flared terminals and sharp, triangular serifs
Variable stroke width with a calligraphic influence
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature an internal 'carved' line or grain
The ampersand and fractions are integrated into the baseline flow
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both top and bottom text to maintain symmetry.
graphicDevices: Horizontal grain texture across the text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the incised, flared-serif character and classical weight.
Similar flared terminals and 70s-era display feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a double exposure portrait of a man in profile, wearing patterned sunglasses, with a heavy horizontal motion blur effect and 1970s film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply all-caps incised serif text at the top and bottom margins, using a wide tracking and a textured, stone-carved fill effect.

verificationChecks: Is the text incised with internal texture?
Is the double exposure effect soft and horizontally blurred?
Are the sunglasses the primary point of sharp detail?

adjustableVariables: Degree of 'chisel' texture in the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial identity of the subject
Exact brand logos or trademarked patterns on eyewear
postGenerationChecks: Check for horizontal motion blur continuity
Verify the 'carved' look of the serif letters
Ensure the profiles face inward/outward symmetrically
Confirm the color palette remains muted and retro
recipe.reuseFormula: Double Exposure Profile + Horizontal Motion Blur + Incised Serif Framing
